ship/index.html.hull: As drawn, the m hull does not float. The house-harsh record basis uses safety factor 1.2 against full sea-level pressure, knockdown 0.30 and 1,050 MPa chords. Its lift is of its mass at sea level and at the 2,500 m working altitude. The best defensible world assumes knockdown 0.65 and a 1,450 MPa carbon-laminate compressive ceiling, both unverified. Its lift/mass is at sea level and at 2,500 m, short by t and t respectively.
ship/index.html.bench: The bench article does not float. Its nominal volume displaces g of air at sea level and g at 2,500 m. Its computed mass is kg, including kg of tube and kg of joints. Weighed parts, load tests and a complete skin and hardware bill are needed to establish its actual mass and capacity.
